Sharath Chandra A, PMP®

Email: sharath@sharathx.com | Mobile: +91 - 9145356789 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sharath-chandra-a-b2794b16/

Professional Summary

PMP® certified Technical Project Manager with 11+ years of IT experience, including 7+ years in project management, delivering enterprise IT Programs, Data, SCM and AI-driven digital transformation initiatives, including chatbot and voicebot platforms. Proven expertise in managing end-to-end delivery, stakeholder alignment while leading cross-functional teams using Scrum and Hybrid methodologies.

Core Competencies Program & Project Delivery | Agile & Waterfall | Business Requirements Gathering & Analysis | Stakeholder Management | RAID & Dependency Management | UAT & Release Governance

Tools & Technologies

PM & Delivery Tools: Jira | ServiceNow | Azure DevOps (Boards) | ClickUp

Data & Analytics: Azure Data Factory (ADF) | Talend | Power BI | Sisense

Technical Awareness: Java | APIs | SQL | Excel | PowerPoint

Professional Experience

Technical Project Manager | Dataflix Technologies Pvt. Ltd. | Jan 2022 - Dec 2025

Project 1: SCM, EDW, ASN, Logistics Automation, Container Count Automation

Client: Nextpower (formerly Nextracker)

Duration: Feb 2022 - Dec 2025

Role: Technical Project Manager

Description:

Led a large-scale digital transformation program for Nextracker focused on modernizing supply chain operations through the Anaplan platform across multiple business processes. The engagement included strategic initiatives involving the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Advanced Shipment Notification (ASN), Logistics and other enterprise transformation programs. As part of the managed services engagement, responsibilities included Anaplan platform operations, production support, incident management, system stability and continuous enhancement to ensure reliable business operations and ongoing process optimization.

Technical Project Manager Responsibilities:

Managed and owned end-to-end delivery of a program consisting of 4+ concurrent projects across Supply Chain (Anaplan), Enterprise Data Platforms, ASN, Logistics and Digital Transformation, overseeing scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, and production releases.

Led SCM (Anaplan) SaaS platform operations, ensuring stability, driving feature enhancements, and aligning with supply chain planning and operation needs, resulting in a 30% performance improvement. • Directed cross-functional teams (14+ members) across development, QA, data engineering, and business functions, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery aligned with business goals.

Designed and implemented end-to-end EDW pipelines using Azure Data Factory, enabling enterprise- wide data integration and analytics while owning and managing the client’s complete EDW ecosystem. • Ensured SLA adherence, issue resolution and quality standards by overseeing data pipelines, monitoring operational KPIs and aligning delivery outcomes with stakeholder expectations.

Scrum Master Responsibilities (Agile Delivery):

Facilitated Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Grooming, Sprint

Reviews and Retrospectives to ensure effective sprint execution and continuous improvement.

Acted as Scrum Master for cross-functional Agile teams delivering IT, SCM initiatives. • Partnered with Product Owners, Business Owners to refine and prioritize product backlogs, ensuring alignment with business priorities and roadmap objectives.

Proactively resolved team impediments and facilitated cross-functional collaboration, driving seamless

sprint execution and enhancing team productivity by ~20% through data-driven insights in Jira.

Technologies: Anaplan, ADF, Power BI, .Net, React, Python, SQL, MySQL, Jira

Project 2: Dealer Case Management, Big Data Platform

Client: Hyundai (HAEA, HACC)

Duration: Feb 2022 - Jan 2024

Role: Project Manager

Description:

Managed a digital transformation program for Hyundai (HAEA, HACC), driving DCM, Big Data, and chatbot initiatives while also overseeing managed services for platform operations, production support and incident management.

Responsibilities:

Owned end-to-end delivery of projects across DCM, Big Data, managing scope, schedules, risks,

dependencies and production releases.

Led cross-functional teams of 6+ members across development, data, and platform engineering,

ensuring on-time delivery aligned with business objectives.

Ensured SLA adherence, issue resolution and quality standards by aligning delivery outcomes with



stakeholder expectations. Implemented an AI chatbot using Dialog flow framework that reduced support tickets by 25%, enhancing process efficiency and improving customer experience.

Technologies: Big Data, .Net, SQL, React, Python, Restful APIs, Dialog Flow, NLP, ServiceNow

Project Coordinator | Kiwi Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. | Nov 2021 - Jan 2022

Project: Internal

Client: Internal

Duration: Nov 2021 - Jan 2022

Role: Project Coordinator

Description:

Participated in requirements gathering and analysis with stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

Conducted requirements gathering sessions to understand business needs, created and analyzed

project requirements documents.

Technologies: Jira

Application Development Senior Analyst | Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | May 2021 - Sep 2021

Project: Internal

Client: Internal Project

Duration: May 2021 - Sep 2021

Role: PMO Lead

Description:

PMO Lead for an internal project, managing project planning, governance, reporting and coordination across multiple teams.

Responsibilities:

As the Project Management Lead, facilitated communication and collaboration between internal

stakeholders, recruitment and TA teams.

Led PMO operations for FS projects, supporting demand fulfillment, resource tracking and executive

reporting across cross-functional teams.

Technologies: JIRA, Java, APIs, SQL etc.

Technical Project Lead | Nxt Serve Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (formerly Network Objects Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) | Mar 2020 - Apr 2021

Project: eZrecover - Collections Management System

Client: Internal (Product)

Duration: Mar 2020 - Apr 2021

Role: Technical Project Lead

Description:

Designed and developed a product to simplify the operations of agencies managing collections for customers across multiple banks. The application is developed to streamline agency workflows, improve customer case management and maintain detailed records of employee activities and customer case histories.

Responsibilities:

Led a product development team of 10 resources, managing task allocation, milestone tracking, delivery

commitments and overall execution to ensure on-time and high-quality outcomes.

Coordinated data

integrations, developing operational dashboards in Metabase, managing testing and deployment of application developed using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL.

integration and reporting

initiatives, overseeing Talend-based

Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, APIs, SQL, MySQL

Programmer, Project Coordinator, IT Consultant | NIC, TSTS (Contract via Multiple Payroll Companies), Hyderabad | Aug 2015 - Mar 2020

Project: eProcurement, Mera Matsyadhan, Kapu Welfare, Digital Panchayat, Mahila Shishu, TS Foods ERP

Client: NIC, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana Govt. (TSTS)

Duration: Aug 2015 - Mar 2020

Role: Programmer, Project Coordinator, IT Consultant

Description:

Contributed to multiple e-Governance programs for the NIC and TSTS as a contract resource, supporting requirements analysis, development, testing and deployment across state-level applications.

Responsibilities:

Designed and developed application modules using Java, performed testing and deployment, and supported delivery through status reporting and cross-team coordination, contributing to the successful rollout of IT applications.

Supported functional documentation, module validation, UAT coordination, and reporting across initiatives including Mera Matsyadhan, Kapu Welfare, Digital Panchayat, Mahila Shishu, TS Foods ERP. • Supported governance and implementation of large-scale government IT initiatives (SWAN, SDC and SOC of Telangana) by coordinating with internal teams, vendors and third-party auditors.

Prepared RFPs, technical documentation and conducted technical tender evaluations. Handled MoM

documentation, weekly status reporting, and preparation of tender finalization drafts.

Technologies: Java (JSP), HTML, APIs, SQL, MySQL

Project Trainee | Codit Solutions | Aug 2014 - Jul 2015

Project: Network Management and Big Data

Client: Internal

Duration: Aug 2014 - Jul 2015

Role: Project Trainee

Description:

POCs on Hadoop and Big Data Implementation.

Responsibilities:

Created and analyzed project requirements documents, contributed to Hadoop and Big Data setup;

experimented with Sqoop data transfer.

Technologies: Hadoop, SQL, MongoDB, MySQL

Education & Certification

Project Management Professional (PMP®) - Project Management Institute (PMI) - Valid until Dec, 2026 • B. Tech - Electronics & Communication Engineering | Sree Dattha Institute of Engineering & Science, JNTU Hyderabad | 2005 - 2009

Double Degree Master’s Courses - Telecommunication Systems | JNTU, Hyderabad / Blekinge Institute

of Technology (BTH), Sweden | 2009 - 2013
